status.description: Only ready permits image preparation; non-ready proposals have null image_spec.

brief_interpretation.description: Concise interpretation of the user communication problem.

chosen_direction.description: Core communication concept and principal signs, before detailed stylistic treatment.

sign_relationships.description: Human-readable Markdown, one subsection per important element: element, referent, justified iconic/indexical/symbolic relationship, grounds for the relationship, and intended reading. Do not force all three categories; state ambiguity.

design_rationale.description: Explain why the selected signs and their combined intended reading suit the communication purpose, audience, and viewing context.

visual_style.description: Derive style from sign_relationships and explain how each defining quality supports a particular intended reading. Treat user-specified style as an initial constraint and describe any resolved tension. Human-readable Markdown with separate subsections for style or reference direction, reasons suited to the task, defining visual qualities, allowed variation and boundaries, and confirmation status. Distinguish user-specified, proposed for review, and explicitly user-confirmed directions; identify supplied evidence for confirmation. Never infer approval from a previous proposal, generated image, or ready status. Name a historical movement only when justified; describe concrete visual qualities in all cases.

graphic_decisions.description: Connect each important choice across the intended sign relationship, supporting style quality, and executable image_spec instruction. Identify relationships that must survive stylistic variation.

assumptions.description: Explicit provisional additions, not confirmed user requirements.

review_criteria.description: Visible criteria for reviewing the poster.

revision_summary.description: Evidence and justified changes after self-review; empty on an initial proposal.

source_requirements.description: Outstanding exact content or source material.

clarification_questions.description: Focused questions that must be answered before proceeding.

image_spec.description: Structured handoff to image generation, or null while blocked.

communication_objective.description: Intended communication, not text to print.

audience_and_context.description: Relevant audience and viewing conditions from the brief or explicitly stated assumptions.

visible_copy.description: Exact strings to appear in the artwork, including intentional line breaks. Empty means no visible text.

composition.description: Concrete arrangement, scale, placement, and visual hierarchy.

typography.description: Typography and text placement. For a text-free poster, explicitly state no typography.

visual_treatment.description: Executable style direction and concrete imagery, palette, surface, and rendering qualities consistent with visual_style. A style name alone is insufficient. Keep selection rationale and confirmation history outside image_spec.

allowed_variation.description: Concrete variations permitted while preserving the specified elements and relationships carrying the concept. Empty means no additional variation is specified.

exclusions.description: Concrete content or visual treatments to avoid.
